note: Realistic filled-in states in the scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. `hasCriticalFinding` covers only an *unexpected* malignancy (malignancyPresent with no originatingRequestReference) or an involved resection margin — a malignancy the requester already anticipated (a linked originating request) still classifies abnormal and drives urgent MDT follow-up, but does not itself escalate to critical-alert. The second and third personas below isolate exactly that expected-vs-unexpected distinction.

personas.name: normal-benign-melanocytic-naevus-complete
personas.description: Excision of a pigmented skin lesion shows a benign compound melanocytic naevus with clear margins and no malignancy, every mandatory report section present — expect normal classification + none severity + 100% completeness + routine follow-up + no-action.

state.clinicalHistory: Excision of a suspicious pigmented lesion on the left forearm for histological assessment.
state.comparisonWithPrevious: No previous biopsy of this lesion.
state.macroscopicDescription: Ellipse of skin measuring 20 x 10mm with a central 4mm pigmented macule. Margins inked.
state.microscopicDescription: Sections show a benign compound melanocytic naevus with no cytological atypia, no mitotic activity, and no evidence of malignancy. Excision margins clear.
state.diagnosis: Benign compound melanocytic naevus, completely excised.
state.impression: Benign melanocytic naevus; no further action required.
state.recommendedFollowUp: No further follow-up required for this benign lesion.

expected.recommendedAction: No specific pathology follow-up required; manage per usual care.

firedRules.description: No malignancy and no abnormal structured findings on an adequate specimen; classified as normal.
No abnormal finding; abnormality severity graded none.
No escalation rule fired; routine follow-up only.

personas.name: abnormal-expected-colorectal-adenocarcinoma-moderate-not-critical-complete
personas.description: A colonic resection for a pre-operatively biopsy-proven and referred colorectal tumour confirms a moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma, pT2 pN0 pM0, with clear margins: malignancy is present but the report is linked to the originating diagnostic-biopsy request, so this is an *expected* (not unexpected) malignancy and does not trigger `hasCriticalFinding` — it grades only moderate severity (not high-grade or nodal/metastatic), yet confirmed malignancy still drives urgent 2-week-wait MDT follow-up regardless of severity; report complete — expect abnormal classification + moderate severity + 100% completeness + urgent follow-up + specialist-referral.

state.clinicalHistory: Anterior resection for a pre-operatively biopsy-proven sigmoid adenocarcinoma; specimen submitted for full pathological staging.
state.comparisonWithPrevious: Correlates with the diagnostic colonoscopic biopsy (REQ-2026-0825-HISTO) confirming adenocarcinoma.
state.macroscopicDescription: Segment of sigmoid colon, 180mm in length, with an ulcerating tumour mass measuring 35mm in maximum dimension. Proximal and distal margins grossly clear.
state.microscopicDescription: Sections show an infiltrating moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma invading into the muscularis propria. No lymphovascular invasion identified. Nine regional lymph nodes examined, all free of tumour.
state.diagnosis: Moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma of the sigmoid colon.
state.impression: pT2 pN0 pM0 moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma of the sigmoid colon, completely excised with clear margins.
state.recommendedFollowUp: Discuss at the colorectal cancer MDT for adjuvant-therapy decision and surveillance planning.
state.reportedTo: Colorectal surgical team and cancer MDT coordinator

expected.recommendedAction: Refer to the cancer multidisciplinary team (MDT) and expedite onward management per the 2-week-wait pathway.

firedRules.description: Malignancy is present; classified as abnormal.
Confirmed malignancy present; abnormality severity graded moderate.
Confirmed malignancy or a major abnormality present; urgent MDT discussion required.

flags.description: Confirmed malignancy requiring timely action is present.
flags.suggestedAction: Ensure the requester is alerted and a clear MDT action plan is documented.

flags.description: Malignancy present; urgent cancer MDT referral is warranted.
flags.suggestedAction: Refer to the cancer MDT and manage per the 2-week-wait suspected-cancer pathway.

personas.name: critical-unexpected-appendiceal-adenocarcinoma-uncommunicated-incomplete
personas.description: A routine appendicectomy for presumed simple appendicitis incidentally shows a poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma with nodal metastasis and lymphovascular invasion: no originating request anticipated a malignancy finding, so this is an *unexpected* malignancy and auto-escalates classification to critical and follow-up to critical-alert regardless of the other axes; the result has not yet been recorded as communicated, and the clinical history, diagnosis, and impression sections are not yet completed while the urgent MDT referral is arranged — expect critical classification + major severity + 40% completeness + critical-alert follow-up + urgent-review.

state.macroscopicDescription: Appendix, 60mm in length, with a firm white tumour mass at the tip measuring 18mm.
state.microscopicDescription: Sections show an infiltrating adenocarcinoma arising in the appendix, poorly differentiated, with invasion through the muscularis propria into the mesoappendix. Regional lymph nodes show metastatic involvement in 2 of 9 nodes examined. Lymphovascular invasion identified.
state.clinicianNotes: Incidental finding on a routine appendicectomy specimen; phoned through to the surgical team immediately and urgent colorectal cancer MDT referral being arranged.

expected.recommendedAction: Communicate the critical result directly to the requester now, refer to the urgent cancer MDT, and document the conversation.

flags.suggestedAction: Communicate the critical result to the requester immediately and document the communication.

flags.suggestedAction: Contact the requester now and record who was informed, with date and time.
